latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of YouTube AI Subtitle Generator.

- Generate AI-powered subtitles in multiple languages for YouTube videos up to 500MB (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM).
- Upload videos, send commands like "generate subtitles in English and Spanish," and download 1080p MP4s.
- Automated setup: handles token and session creation, prompts progress and readiness.
- Supports session management, credit checks, export, and error reporting for a smooth user experience.
- Handles video editing, subtitle timing, and batch or iterative workflows server-side—no manual setup required.
